sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 160. Success value 100. 5x magic damage (Fire).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Removes buffs.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 100. Applies stun.
-Target: all enemies. Increases physical and magic Ability Power of damage taken by 30 for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces healing received by 40% for 60 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies kijin (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies debuffs; nullifies Unison gauge reduction; boosts Ability Power of critical hits by 50; increases attack Ability accuracy by 30%; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking) for 60 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 8000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 8000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all enemies. Reduces Unison gauge gains by 2 for 60 seconds.
Only [Festival] Shishimai Limimin can be used as Unlocking Potential material
